irrig_03.note: Soybean climate requirement on p185 says soybean 'can withstand short periods of waterlogging and short drought'. The gold passage on p186 says soybean is 'very sensitive to excess moisture and the crop is affected, if water stagnates in the fields'. The two passages are not interchangeable and are not merged; p186 stays the only exact evidence.

fert_01.note: Other groundnut gypsum statements with the same 400 kg/ha rate but different timing wording: p197 'Gypsum 400 kg/ha as soil application at 45th day after sowing' (sulphur deficiency), p208 'Apply gypsum @ 400 kg / ha at peg formation stage and at earthing'. Unresolved source-reference nuance; p203 stays the primary evidence and the recommendations are not merged.

fert_01_alt.note: Same related groundnut gypsum passages as fert_01 (p197, p208); not counted as exact evidence.
